description: Administrable catalog of risk identification prompts (ADR-0016). Questions are grouped by section (generic + specialized). The Project Risk Assessment prefills its questionnaire from the ACTIVE questions and snapshots them, so later catalog edits never alter existing assessments.

fields.description: Stable identifier (used for i18n and as the snapshot reference on each assessment). Renaming a question's text never changes its code.
fields.label: Code

fields.description: Inactive questions are not prefilled into new assessments (existing assessments keep their snapshot).
fields.label: Active

fields.description: Generic sections apply to any project; specialized sections (e.g. Information Technology) group domain prompts. New sections are added through the app's normal versioned mechanism (never a Property Setter).
fields.label: Section
fields.options:
External dependencies
Scope & requirements
Schedule
Cost / economic
Resources & team
Stakeholders & governance
Information Technology

fields.description: Display order within the section (ascending). Left blank on new questions, the next value in steps of 10 within the section is generated automatically; you can set it manually to reorder.
fields.label: Sort order

fields.description: Identification prompt. It is a yes/no applicability question, not the risk itself: when it applies, the team writes the concrete risk statement on the assessment. Stored in the working language; translatable to other languages via Frappe's translation mechanism.
fields.label: Question

name: PMO Risk Question
